keeping_it_together.name: Keeping It Together
nervous_twitch.name: Nervous Twitch
nervous_twitch.desc: Stress +1 for you and for friendly PCs at short range.
tremble.name: Tremble
tremble.desc: −2 to skill rolls based on AGILITY until the panic stops.
drop_item.name: Drop Item
drop_item.desc: You drop a weapon or another important item; the GM picks which. Stress +1.
freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.desc: Rigid for one Round, the next slow action is lost. Stress +1 for you and for friendly PCs at short range.
seek_cover.name: Seek Cover
seek_cover.desc: Next action: get away from the danger to a safe spot. Your stress −1, friendly PCs at short range stress +1. Back to normal after one Round.
seek_cover.hint: Must use the next action to move away from the danger. A retreat roll is allowed if an enemy is at ENGAGED range.
scream.name: Scream
scream.desc: Screams for one Round, the next slow action is lost. Your stress −1; friendly characters who hear it make a Panic Roll at once.
flee.name: Flee
flee.desc: Flees to a safe place and stays there. Your stress −1; friendly characters who see it make a Panic Roll at once.
flee.hint: Flees and stays in the safe place: no attacks, nothing dangerous, no retreat roll.
berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.desc: Attacks the nearest person or creature at once, friend or foe. Friendly characters who witness it make a Panic Roll at once.
berserk.hint: Attacks the nearest person or creature and only stops once they or the target is Broken.
catatonic.name: Catatonic
catatonic.desc: Collapses; can neither talk nor move.
catatonic.hint: Lies on the floor, does not talk, does not move.
phobia.name: Phobia
phobia.desc: Fear of something linked to the panic; the GM decides what.
phobia.hint: At short range of the phobia's object: stress +1. Close to it for more than one Round: Panic Roll.
alcoholism.name: Alcoholism
alcoholism.question: Did the character drink alcohol this Shift?
alcoholism.hint: Stress can only be relieved while drinking alcohol.
nightmares.name: Nightmares
nightmares.desc: EMPATHY roll when sleeping; on a nightmare stress +1 and no stress relief for a full day.
depression.name: Depression
depression.desc: Daily EMPATHY roll; on a failure stress +1 and no stress relief until the next day.
drug_use.name: Drug Use
drug_use.question: Did the character take their drug this Shift?
drug_use.hint: Stress can only be relieved with the character's drug.
amnesia.name: Amnesia
amnesia.desc: No longer remembers who they or the others are.
sprained_ankle.name: Sprained Ankle
sprained_ankle.desc: MOBILITY −2 and no running until a MEDICAL AID roll succeeds.
crotch_hit.name: Crotch Hit
crotch_hit.desc: Every MOBILITY or CLOSE COMBAT roll costs 1 damage.
broken_ribs.name: Broken Ribs
ruptured_jugular.name: Ruptured Jugular
ruptured_jugular.desc: Fatal: Death Roll after one Round; MEDICAL AID to save it at −1. STAMINA −1.
freezing.name: Freezing
freezing.desc: No healing, no stress relief. STAMINA rolls depending on the cold; failure: 1 damage and stress +1. Ends once warm.
freezing.broken: Broken while Freezing: the next cold roll becomes a Death Roll.
the_long_haul.name: The Long Haul
the_long_haul.desc: Once per Act (Cinematic) or session (Campaign): ignore all facehuggers of one roll.
nerves_of_steel.name: Nerves of Steel
displacement_drive.name: Displacement Drive
galley.name: Galley
docking_umbilical.name: Docking Umbilical
artificial_gravity.name: Artificial Gravity
intercom.name: Intercom
life_support.name: Life Support
artificial_gravity_malfunction.name: Artificial Gravity Malfunction
artificial_gravity_malfunction.run_faile: MOBILITY roll failed. The book does not say what happens then; the GM decides.
coffee_maker_malfunction.name: Coffee Maker Malfunction
coffee_maker_malfunction.desc: The galley's coffee maker is out of order.
displacement_drive_malfunction.name: Displacement Drive Malfunction
displacement_drive_malfunction.desc: FTL rating changed; see ruling F-02.
intercoms_disabled.name: Intercoms Disabled
intercoms_disabled.hint: Talking only to people in the same area.
life_support_offline.name: Life Support Offline
life_support_offline.desc: Everyone aboard not wearing a vacuum-proof suit is Freezing and rolls STAMINA every Shift.

past_the_limit.name: Past the Limit
past_the_limit.desc: Push skill rolls based on STRENGTH twice; each push stress +1.
overkill.name: Overkill
overkill.desc: On a Panic Roll of 11 or more with enemies in sight, choose the Overkill effect instead.
authority.name: Authority
authority.desc: Use COMMAND instead of MANIPULATION to make someone give in.
cunning.name: Cunning
cunning.desc: Push skill rolls based on WITS twice; each push stress +1.
take_control.name: Take Control
take_control.desc: Roll MANIPULATION with WITS instead of EMPATHY.
nimble.name: Nimble
nimble.desc: Push skill rolls based on AGILITY twice; each push stress +1.
compassion.name: Compassion
compassion.desc: Push skill rolls based on EMPATHY twice; each push stress +1.
influence.name: Influence
influence.desc: Push skill rolls based on EMPATHY twice; each push stress +1.
reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.desc: Push skill rolls based on AGILITY twice; each push stress +1.
true_grit.name: True Grit
true_grit.desc: Push skill rolls based on STRENGTH twice; each push stress +1.
breakthrough.name: Breakthrough
breakthrough.desc: Once per session pass an OBSERVATION roll without rolling; the GM may forbid it.
inquisitive.name: Inquisitive
inquisitive.desc: Push skill rolls based on WITS twice; each push stress +1.
calm_breather.name: Calm Breather
calm_breather.desc: Air supply rolls use two dice fewer, at least one.
light_eater.name: Light Eater
light_eater.desc: Food supply rolls use two dice fewer, at least one.
menacing.name: Menacing
menacing.desc: When threatening, roll MANIPULATION with STRENGTH instead of EMPATHY. On a success the other side can ask for nothing in return but may attack.
stoic.name: Stoic
stoic.desc: Roll STAMINA with WITS instead of STRENGTH, also for the Death Roll (F-46).
overkill_effect.name: Overkill
overkill_effect.desc: Attacks the enemies at once until oneself or all enemies in sight are Broken. All other PCs at short range make a Panic Roll.
overkill_effect.hint: Attacks the enemies until oneself or all enemies in sight are Broken.

colonial_marine.agenda.hero: You are a decorated hero. Protect your reputation, whatever it takes.
colonial_marine.agenda.cover_up: You helped hide a war crime. Nobody may ever find out.
colonial_marine.agenda.fear: Since your buddy died, you secretly fear combat. Overcome it.
colonial_marshal.item.dented_flask_with_: Dented flask with an inscription on the front
colonial_marshal.item.news_clipping_of_a: News clipping of an unsolved case
colonial_marshal.agenda.partner: Your old partner betrayed you and joined a syndicate. Pay them back.
colonial_marshal.agenda.badge: You want to hand in the badge and settle down. Work toward it.
colonial_marshal.agenda.past: An old misdeed has caught up with you. Show what you are made of.
company_agent.agenda.power: You crave power. Use every chance to get ahead.
company_agent.agenda.withheld: The Company keeps something from you. Find out what, and why.
company_agent.agenda.blackmail: The Company blackmails you into dirty work. Get even.
kid.agenda.trust: Find a grown-up you can really trust.
kid.agenda.alone: No family is left to you. Never end up on your own again.
kid.agenda.fun: Nobody gives you anything to do. Explore and have your own fun.
medic.item.last_psych_evaluation_all_cl: Last psych evaluation: "All clear at last."
medic.agenda.painkiller: You depend on a strong painkiller. Guard your supply and your secret.
medic.agenda.reports: You carry secret medical reports the Company wants. Learn why.
medic.agenda.oath: You have sworn never to kill, and you keep that oath.
officer.agenda.promotion: Your family expects a promotion or a medal from you, and soon.
officer.agenda.blame: You made a mistake once. Never take the blame for another.
officer.agenda.mistakes: Mistakes kill. Nobody under you makes one, and they must know why.
pilot.agenda.limit: Push the limit and take risks.
pilot.agenda.stubborn: You never back down, even if friends could get hurt.
pilot.agenda.loner: You prefer to get things done without relying on others.
roughneck.agenda.thrills: You crave thrills. When there is a risk, you step up.
roughneck.agenda.friends: You gave up your family for the job. Never let your friends down.
roughneck.agenda.downtime: Time off matters: a cold beer and some peace and quiet.
scientist.agenda.stolen: Your last project was stolen. Keep your findings to yourself.
scientist.agenda.authority: You hate authority. Refuse to cooperate whenever you can.
scientist.agenda.delegate: You struggle to hand off work, even if it means doing more.
banter.name: Banter
banter.desc: Resting somewhere safe lowers your stress and that of everyone within SHORT range by two steps per Turn instead of one; several Marines with it do not add up.
investigator.name: Investigator
investigator.desc: Spend a Turn in a room and roll OBSERVATION, once per place. For each success ask the GM one question: what happened, what is hidden, what is out of place.
subdue.name: Subdue
subdue.desc: In close combat against a humanoid, declare a subdue attempt: +2, and a hit holds the opponent in a grapple instead of dealing damage.
personal_safety.name: Personal Safety
personal_safety.desc: When attacked or in mortal danger, roll MANIPULATION; on a success a friendly character within SHORT range takes it instead. Using it costs stress +1.
beneath_notice.name: Beneath Notice
beneath_notice.desc: When you roll a critical injury on yourself, roll again and keep the result you prefer.
dodge.name: Dodge
dodge.desc: When attacked in close combat, dodge like a block but with MOBILITY; your successes only cancel the attacker's. Works even against signature attacks.
calming_presence.name: Calming Presence
calming_presence.desc: Once per Turn, without rolling, ease another character's stress within SHORT range by one if you are both fairly safe.
field_surgeon.when: treating someone dying of a critical injury
field_surgeon.name: Field Surgeon
field_surgeon.desc: +2 to MEDICAL AID when treating someone about to die of a critical injury.
field_commander.name: Field Commander
field_commander.desc: Give orders with COMMAND as a fast action, so twice per Round.
pull_rank.name: Pull Rank
pull_rank.desc: Roll COMMAND against the MANIPULATION of a non-officer from your organization; on a success they must carry out one order. Stress +1 each time; useless against panic.
full_throttle.name: Full Throttle
full_throttle.desc: +2 to PILOTING when accelerating or decelerating a spacecraft.
like_the_back_of_your_hand.name: Like the Back of Your Hand
like_the_back_of_your_hand.desc: Choose one particular vehicle or spacecraft: +2 to PILOTING with it. Can be taken for several.
resilient.name: Resilient
resilient.desc: Whenever you take damage, roll STRENGTH; each success removes one point. The roll cannot be pushed.
analysis.name: Analysis
analysis.desc: Study a strange artifact or creature for a Turn and roll OBSERVATION; ask one question per success. Success lowers the stress of other PCs within SHORT range by one, failure raises it.
bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.desc: When someone within SHORT range is hit, roll MOBILITY; with a success you take the hit instead. The roll can be pushed.
counselor.name: Counselor
counselor.desc: Once per Turn use COMMAND on another character within SHORT range: each success lowers their stress by one extra step.
eva_specialist.name: EVA Specialist
eva_specialist.desc: +2 to HEAVY MACHINERY and COMTECH on a spacewalk.
fast_reflexes.name: Fast Reflexes
fast_reflexes.desc: Draw two initiative cards, keep one and shuffle the other back before anyone else draws.
flyweight.name: Flyweight
flyweight.desc: Block in close combat with AGILITY instead of STRENGTH.
hard_hitter.name: Hard Hitter
hard_hitter.desc: +2 to CLOSE COMBAT if you give up your fast action.
healer.name: Healer
healer.desc: Your critical injuries heal in half the time.
hidden_stash.name: Hidden Stash
hidden_stash.desc: At the start of each session gain one extra item of your choice, hidden on you or somewhere safe; the GM has the final say.
hothead.when: someone tries to give you orders
hothead.name: Hothead
hothead.desc: +2 to opposed MANIPULATION rolls when someone tries to give you orders, also against Pull Rank.
killer.name: Killer
killer.desc: When an enemy suffers a critical injury, you may swap the two D66 digits. Only against humans.
light_sleeper.name: Light Sleeper
light_sleeper.desc: You need one Shift of sleep every two days instead of every day.
machinegunner.name: Machinegunner
machinegunner.desc: Firing full auto does not raise your stress.
merciless.name: Merciless
merciless.desc: Deliver a coup de grâce without the EMPATHY roll and without stress (F-07); your stress drops by one each time you make an enemy Broken.
pack_mule.name: Pack Mule
pack_mule.desc: Carry twice as much as normal without being encumbered.
quick_draw.name: Quick Draw
quick_draw.desc: Drawing a weapon costs no action.
rapid_fire.name: Rapid Fire
rapid_fire.desc: Fire a pistol or rifle as a fast action, at −2.
rapid_reload.name: Rapid Reload
second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.desc: When Broken, roll STAMINA to get up at once without first aid; each success restores one Health. Once per Turn, no help against critical injuries.
spaceship_commander.name: Spaceship Commander
spaceship_commander.desc: As captain in space combat, draw two initiative cards and keep one.
spaceship_gunner.when: as a gunner in space combat
spaceship_gunner.name: Spaceship Gunner
spaceship_gunner.desc: +2 to RANGED COMBAT as a gunner in space combat.
spaceship_mechanic.name: Spaceship Mechanic
spaceship_mechanic.desc: +2 to HEAVY MACHINERY or COMTECH when repairing damage to a spacecraft.
stealthy.name: Stealthy
tough.name: Tough
watchful.name: Watchful
watchful.desc: +2 to OBSERVATION for noticing a sneak attack.
weapon_specialist.name: Weapon Specialist
weapon_specialist.desc: Choose a weapon model, or unarmed: +2 when using it. Can be taken for several weapons.
zero_g_training.name: Zero-G Training
investigator.questions: One question to the GM per success.
analysis.questions: One question to the GM per success.
investigate.name: Investigate
analyze.name: Analyze
pull_rank_order.name: Enforce an order
pull_rank.android: Androids have no stress: Pull Rank costs nothing here. The game master decides on consequences (F-55).
